text:
emma.marketing: Quick triage  final checklist for next-week launch + webinar post. Need: 1) frozen KW list for hero + meta, 2) JSON-LD (Event + VideoObject + FAQ + HowTo), 3) internal link map with anchor copy, 4) redirect consolidation plan. Can @ryan_seo and @claire_ops review? doc: https://tiny.redwood/launch-seo-sprint

ryan_seo: I'm on KW intent and longtail pulls. Proposed canonical: /learn/benchmark-story. Product page /product/benchmarks should be canonicalized to that via rel=canonical and contextual links. Seed KWs to include in H1/intro: "LLM inference benchmarks", "inference latency benchmark", "inference cost per token". I'll add 5 prioritized longtails and suggested meta-description.

claire_ops: Canonical locked: https://redwood.com/learn/benchmark-story. UTM pattern for paid + email: ?utm_source=paid&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_m1. I'll coordinate the redirect window and QA steps with eng-release.

ryan_seo: Longtails (draft): "GPU inference throughput comparisons", "batching vs latency tradeoffs for LLMs", "estimate inference cost per request", "quantized vs fp16 latency benchmarks", "best practices for production LLM benchmarks". Anchor plan: link hero to /docs/batching (anchor: "batching and latency tradeoffs"), CTAs to /pricing ("inference pricing examples"), and case studies to /case-studies ("benchmark case studies"). Avoid generic "read more" anchors.

nate_release: Redirect scan flagged /benchmarks-campaign -> 302 -> /promo/old-bench. That path collides with planned promos. We should 301 -> /learn/benchmark-story and remove query-string redirects.

deploy-bot: redirect-scan: /benchmarks-campaign -> 302 -> /promo/old-bench. Recommendation: create 301 /benchmarks-campaign -> /learn/benchmark-story. Commands: `redirect-scan --path /benchmarks*` then `redirect-plan --create 301 /benchmarks-campaign /learn/benchmark-story --note "promo consolidation"`.

emma.marketing: Good catch. Ryan + Claire, freeze keywords & schema by EOD. Claire, please open release ticket for redirect consolidation and include rollback steps. Nate, coordinate timing.

nate_release: Opened REL-4210 for redirect consolidation + canonical swap, assigned to eng-release. Cutover ETA Tue 9am PT, rollback at 9:30am PT. QA checklist in ticket: 1) Screaming Frog crawl for redirect chains; 2) JSON-LD validation via https://validator.schema.org; 3) confirm rel=canonical points to /learn/benchmark-story; 4) mobile UA smoke test.

ryan_seo: I'll paste JSON-LD snippets for Event + VideoObject + HowTo in the doc. Notes: set `mainEntityOfPage` to canonical, include transcript in VideoObject.text, and keep FAQ questions concise. Also recommend short HowTo steps (3 steps) to increase rich result coverage.

emma.marketing: Perfect. Action items: ryan finalize KW list + JSON-LD, claire schedule redirect + release ticket ownership, nate run cutover and QA. Ping this thread when each item is done. Promo copy will ship after redirects confirmed. :rocket:
